notes.title: Happy Birthday to us! Kaiju Kite Attack is 1 year old!!!!
notes.notes:
Happy Birthday to us, [b]PWCA[/b]!!!

[b]Kaiju Kite Attack[/b] is 1 year old today, and we couldn't be more proud. It seems like just yesterday when the Kite Knight first took flight... 

To celebrate, the Kite's flying into an all-new place with an all-new price. That's right! Get your kite in the sky for an [b]ALL-NEW PRICE *** $7.99 ***[/b]! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120640/Kaiju_Kite_Attack/?beta=0 

And tell your friends they can now fly on over to https://pwcagames.itch.io/kaiju-kite-attack @ [b]itch.io[/b] to pick up a copy. So now there's two places you can find the game Defunct Games called, "[b]one of the wildest, craziest and most exciting shoot 'em ups of the year![/b]" 

Most importantly, [b]THANK YOU!!![/b] Much thanks to all the Kite Knights who have bravely stared certain death in its ugly Kaiju face and asked for more. You faced impossible odds, Kaiju blood staining your kite string, but you flew on. Thank you!!! Thank you for playing! If you've had a blast killing Kaiju this past year, please [b]fly on over to the store page and celebrate by leaving a review[/b]. [b]PWCA[/b] thanks you! The Universe thanks you! 

-[b]PWCA[/b]
